seo.title: Decibel — Sound Level Meter for iPhone and Apple Watch
seo.description: See how loud it is around you and when it starts to harm your hearing. A-weighted decibels, NIOSH limits and a live noise dose, saved readings, Apple Health, widgets and an Apple Watch app. No accounts, no tracking.

hero.label: SOUND LEVEL METER
hero.title: Know when it gets too loud.
text: Decibel measures the sound around you and tells you when it's loud enough to harm your hearing, using the NIOSH limits workplaces rely on. Ink on paper, with color only where it matters: on a level past 85 dB.

items.title: A Real Meter
items.text: A-weighted decibels with Fast time weighting, the way a sound level meter reads, and a graph of the last 30 seconds. Each session keeps its average, peak and quietest level. Tap the number to hold it.

items.title: NIOSH Limits
items.text: Above 85 dB, Decibel marks the level and tells you how long a day is safe at it. Your noise dose shows how much of a day's limit a session has used.

items.title: Readings and Places
items.text: Save a reading with the place and a note. Browse by date or by place, see your loudest places side by side, and export everything to CSV.

items.title: Apple Health
items.text: Turn it on and each reading you save is added to Apple Health as Environmental Sound Levels. Decibel never reads your health data.

items.title: Widgets and Apple Watch
items.text: Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show your last reading. The Apple Watch app measures with the watch's own microphone.

items.title: Completely Private
items.text: No accounts, no analytics, no tracking. Sound is measured on your device and never recorded, and your readings stay on it.

sections.title: Zero data collection.
text: No analytics. No ads. No tracking. No accounts. Decibel measures sound on your device and never records, stores or sends audio. Readings stay on your iPhone, and go to Apple Health only if you turn that on.
